sloka: अर्थितो ह्यस्मि कैकेय्या वनम् गच्छेति राघव ।मया चोक्तं प्रजामीति तत्सत्यमनुपालये ॥२-३४-५०॥
transliteration: arthito hyasmi kaikeyyā vanam gaccheti rāghava ।mayā coktaṁ prajāmīti tatsatyamanupālaye ॥2-34-50॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, go to the forest', Kaikeyi had said, and I have given her word I would go. I must fulfil my promise.
